188:t_1:83.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's the original name for $$次元力$$. It's also called the power of the $$源理$$.」

188:t_1:85.en:
$$アルト$$
「Now I vaguely understand why that $$バルビエル$$ recruited $n.」

188:t_1:86.en:
$$シン$$
「That guy... the Reactor in the Empire?」

188:t_1:87.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yeah... It's not only his combat strength. His cunning way of fighting makes him a major threat.」

188:t_1:88.en:
$$レド$$
「But I hear that this $c also has a full set of people who hold Spheres.」

188:t_1:90.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry to let you down, $$レド$$, but compared to the Empire's Reactors, me, $$セツコ$$, and $n are all still pretty green...」

188:t_1:91.en:
$$ランド$$
「On top of that, that bastard $$バルビエル$$ hasn't shown us the limit of his power either.」

188:t_1:92.en:
$n
「$$尸空#pilot$$, who we fought at the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, was the same...」

188:t_1:93.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Did you and the others fight $$尸空#pilot$$ too, $n?」

188:t_1:94.en:
$n
「Yes... I think he probably came to investigate us, since we destroyed the $$時の牢獄$$.」

188:t_1:95.en:
$$シン$$
「He was clearly holding back back then.」

188:t_1:96.en:
$$宗介$$
「But worn down by back-to-back battles and left battered by the fight with him, we ended up allowing the $$サイデリアル$$ invasion that followed...」

188:t_1:97.en:
$$アルト$$
「In a way, his existence is what created Earth's current situation.」

188:t_1:98.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Basically, we've gotta pay that bastard back.」

188:t_1:99.en:
$$マオ$$
「And not just us, but all of $$蒼の地球$$.」

188:t_1:100.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We fought him on $$翠の地球$$ too, before we joined up with $c...」

188:t_1:101.en:
$$メール$$
「Honestly, having to fight that gloomy killer again is going to get me down...」

188:t_1:108.en:
$$シン$$
「If $$セツコ$$ and $$ランド$$ felt it too, that means...」

188:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「So a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ is here...!」

188:t_2:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Where has the $$クラッシャー隊$$ been all this time!? And with Earth in such big trouble!」

188:t_2:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「Sorry. But we were on a mission, too.」

188:t_2:7.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「For the past two months, the $$クラッシャー隊$$ has been surveying the Solar System.」

188:t_2:9.en:
$$ナオト$$
「To investigate the effects after the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed.」

188:t_2:10.en:
$$アキラ$$
「The Solar System now has two Earths and two Moons, but every other planet has only one.」

188:t_2:11.en:
$$ミカ$$
「According to the scientists' research, the two worlds are overlapped within the Solar System, but only around Earth does each of them exist separately.」

188:t_2:12.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Put simply, it's the same situation as when there were two Japanese archipelagos in the $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

188:t_2:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「No way...! I'm just pretending I get it.」

188:t_2:17.en:
$$恵子$$
「Please ignore $$勝平$$ and go on.」

188:t_2:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「We were investigating the conditions of each planet in the Solar System, and we found out a few things that concern us.」

188:t_2:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「First, near the outskirts of the Solar System, we found an area where the dimensional boundary line is extremely warped.」

188:t_2:21.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「We thought it might be for the ultra-long-range space travel the $$サイデリアル$$ use, but...」

188:t_2:22.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Judging from their movements, it doesn't seem to be that.」

188:t_2:23.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「So in the end, you couldn't find out the cause or what's going on inside the distortion?」

188:t_2:25.en:
$$ミカ$$
「We brought back observation data, so we plan to go over it carefully later.」

188:t_2:26.en:
$$アキラ$$
「The other surprise was that people live on Saturn.」

188:t_2:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「Saturn, the one with the rings...!?」

188:t_2:28.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「To be precise, not Saturn itself but its moon, $$タイタン$$.」

188:t_2:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well, well... it seems we've been found.」

188:t_2:31.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm $$ニコラス・バセロン$$. A member of the $$フラタニティ$$.」

188:t_2:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「I see... So you're one of the $$タイタン$$ people's comrades.」

188:t_2:33.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm $$明神タケル$$. Nice to meet you.」

188:t_2:34.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis...! A handsome, classic super robot pilot!」

188:t_2:35.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I get it, so stop making such a fuss. It's embarrassing.」

188:t_2:36.en:
$$チコ$$
「Hmm... so that's the type $$ノノ$$ goes for.」

188:t_2:37.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! He totally has the air of a champion of justice!」

188:t_2:39.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Good looks aside, aren't we the classic type too!?」

188:t_2:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$勝平$$, $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ are a bit too young.」

188:t_2:41.en:
$$ノノ$$
「After all, to be the classic type, you need to be at the age that has both an adult's strength and a child's purity!」

188:t_2:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Tch... We don't want to hear that from $$ノノ$$, with her kid's brain in a grown-up's body...」

188:t_2:43.en:
$$タケル$$
「Don't mind it, $$ワッ太$$. $$ワッ太$$, $$勝平$$ and $$正太郎$$ will all be grown up in no time.」

188:t_2:44.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That! That's it! This freshness is the absolute requirement for being the classic type!」

188:t_2:45.en:
$$恵子$$
「Looks like $$タケル$$ hasn't changed a bit.」

188:t_2:46.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Right. That's what's good about $$マーズ$$.」

188:t_2:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You're welcome to call me $$ニコラ$$.」

188:t_2:49.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Then, $$ニコラ$$... We were refused docking at the $$タイタン$$ base.」

188:t_2:50.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「They called themselves $$トップレス$$ too. So they must be your comrades, but do you have any idea why?」

188:t_2:51.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The mission of the $$トップレス$$ is to intercept the $$宇宙怪獣$$. Beyond that, I suppose they have no intention of actively getting involved with the people of this world.」

ニコラス.evidence: Kenji addresses Nicola by given name ニコラス君; Nicola then offers ニコラ. Sheet only has ニコラス・バセロン (Nicola Vacheron).

kept_omissions: 188:t_1:86: そいつ kept as 'That guy' (referent Barbiel, from the row before); the Reactor 'in the Empire' may also be read as a general statement
188:t_2:42: 言われたくないよな has no subject; rendered 'We' (Watta muttering to Kappei/Shotaro), could be 'I'
uncertain: 188:t_1:100: あの人 rendered 'him' = Shikuu (Setsuko's 'too' in 1:93 and Mel's 'gloomy killer' settle it); could conceivably be Barbiel
188:t_1:86: 皇国にいるリアクター left as 'the Reactor in the Empire' (Barbiel, or Sidereal Reactors generally)
188:t_2:46: マーズ rendered plain 'Mars' (Takeru's Godmars nickname as used by Roze); no glossary token, reader may take it as the planet
188:t_2:47: Kenji's ニコラス君 -> new token $$ニコラス$$ = Nicholas (sheet renders ニコラス・バセロン as Nicola Vacheron, so the given name alone has no entry)
正統派 rendered 'classic (type)' throughout 2:34-44; 'orthodox' was the alternative
188:t_1:84: thought addressed to Kaname as 千鳥さん, token $$千鳥$$ (Chidori) as in Jigoku
188:t_2:3: caption layout copied from the Jigoku English for identical Japanese
